user.title: Connect to a Data Enabler
user.description: Enter the IPv4 address of each Philips Color Kinetics Data Enabler, one per line. The integration sends a read-only supply poll to each address. Add the integration again if a later supply needs a different KiNET mode.

data_description.hosts: Example: 172.16.10.41. One address per line, or separated by commas.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach {host} on UDP port 6038. Check the address and that Home Assistant is on the same network. Only a read-only supply poll was sent.
error.invalid_host: Enter one or more IPv4 unicast addresses, one per line.
error.no_hosts: Enter at least one Data Enabler IP address.
error.already_configured: One of these Data Enablers is already configured.

abort.already_configured: This Data Enabler is already configured.

init.title: Color Kinetics options
init.description: Light data is unicast KiNET. v2 PORTOUT with header version 1 matches OLA. If a fixture stays dark, try header version 2, then v1 DMXOUT. The output port applies to PORTOUT only. These settings apply to every supply in this entry.

data_description.hosts: One IPv4 address per line. A new address is polled before it is saved. Removing an address stops sending to that supply.
data_description.protocol: PORTOUT is KiNET v2. DMXOUT is KiNET v1.
data_description.output_port: Physical output on the Data Enabler, 1 to 16. This supply uses port 1. Ignored for DMXOUT.
data_description.manual_fixtures: One fixture per line if discovery misses it: serial_or_label, dmx_start[, label]. DMX start is 1-based, as QuickPlay shows it. An 8-digit hex token is a serial. With more than one supply, start the line with the supply IP. Example: 880055BE, 1, Oak left

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach {host}. The new address was not saved. Only a read-only supply poll was sent.
error.invalid_host: Enter one or more IPv4 unicast addresses, one per line.
error.no_hosts: Leave at least one Data Enabler address.
error.already_configured: One of these Data Enablers is already configured on another entry.

scan_in_progress.message: A fixture scan is already running on {host}.

scan_failed.title: Fixture scan failed for {host}
scan_failed.description: The Data Enabler did not return a fixture list. Fixtures found earlier were left in place. Check the network and press Rescan fixtures. The scan is read-only, but it takes about 14 seconds and may blink fixtures.

supply_unreachable.title: Data Enabler {host} did not answer
supply_unreachable.description: A read-only supply poll got no reply. Light commands are still sent to the last known address. Discovery results were not cleared.
